text:
Jordan: Quick postmortem from the v3.1-int8 onboarding run. overall quality looks fine but a specific long-seq slice shows regression in ROUGE and huge p99+p999 tail jumps. posting eval-bot summary below.
Nina: share the eval link pls.
Jordan: eval-bot posted:

```
Global: ROUGE-L -0.3 pts, avg latency +40ms
Slices:
- short-chat: ROUGE +0.1 | p99 +10ms
- code-assist: ROUGE +0.5 | p99 +30ms
- long-seq-docs: ROUGE -1.2 | p95 +210ms | p99 +490ms | p999 +1100ms
- citation-heavy: ROUGE -0.6 | p99 +150ms
- error-rate: +0.002 (ppm)
```

Hari: that long-seq regression is material. customers that do chunked summarization will see timeouts.
Priya: any infra signal? queue depth or kernel falls back?
Jordan: ops checked GPU queues: fine. runtime logs show occasional kernel fallback on attention matmul for long context, and higher host-side tokenization time for very long inputs.
Nina: interesting 12 if the int8 kernel triggers an alternate slower path for certain seq lengths, that could explain p999 spikes.
Hari: proposal: implement two-tier gate that first throttles split weight/traffic for impacted slices and then triggers full fallback to baseline if latency+quality hit persists. include automated sample capture and kernel trace when the gate fires.
Priya: sketch of gating config we can add to the onboarding repo:

```
gates:
  - id: longseq_protect_v3p1
    target_slices: ["long-seq-docs","citation-heavy"]
    evaluate_interval: 1m
    conditions:
      - metric: p99_latency_ms
        delta_above: 300    # ms above baseline
      - metric: rouge_l_delta
        below: -0.5           # absolute points worse
    actions_sequence:
      - action: reduce_weight
        params: {percent: 50, capture_sample: true, capture_kernel_trace: true}
        duration: 5m
      - action: shadow_replay
        params: {replay_target: baseline, compare_window: 10m}
      - action: fallback_to_baseline
        params: {reason: "sustained_slice_regression"}
    hysteresis: 8m
    auto_unwind: true
```

Jordan: note the shadow_replay step will run baseline in parallel for captured samples so we can compare outputs automatically. eval-bot will post a diff summary.
Nina: love the auto_unwind flag so we don't oscillate. require 2 consecutive evaluate intervals before escalation.
Hari: also add a decay policy: when reduce_weight is applied, drop weight by percent, then if metric improves by 30% of the delta, step back by half. helps avoid abrupt toggles.
Priya: ops: can we ensure artifact_store retention is at least 7 days for captured kernels and samples? we might need to hand them to research.
ops-bot: retention policy updated for folder: /canary-captures/1767774321 -> 7d.
Jordan: one more operational item: enable runtime flag to log kernel selection and attention-block decomposition for sampled requests so ML team can see which code path triggered. set sampling to 1 in 1000 for prod, 1 in 100 for staging.
Nina: will add diag-parsing script to the eval runner to surface kernel fallback counts.
Hari: test plan:
- push gate to staging with synthetic long-seq generator that mimics token expansion patterns
- confirm reduce_weight triggers and sample capture works
- run shadow_replay and validate ROUGE diffs
- if stable, roll gate to prod as opt-in for next 24h for 5% traffic

Priya: ETA?
Jordan: I'll open PR now with gating yaml and runbook links. aiming for staging deploy by EOD. PR link in thread when ready.
Nina: will review PR fast.
Hari: Ill prepare synthetic generator and perf harness.
Jordan: thanks all. will follow up with eval-bot diffs once shadow runs finish.
